name: collatz_haunt

phase_0.boundary_condition: The 2-adic integer -1 (the infinite survivor 2^k - 1) which defines the scale-invariant limit of the depth-k split

⊢.justification: The initial integer n before any Collatz iteration or depth-k analysis is applied.

⊣.justification: The closed boundary of the system where the all-odd class 2^k - 1 converges to the 2-adic integer -1.

≻.justification: The forward morphism (3n+1)/2 that increases the value and increments the odd-step count j.

≺.justification: The reverse/descent morphism n/2 that decreases the value and preserves the odd-step count.

⋈.justification: The sequential composition of k steps forming the affine map col^[k] on a residue class.

⊙.justification: The identity of the residue class r mod 2^k which determines the parity sequence independently of the quotient t.

∈.justification: The split of the trajectory into the T-arm (odd step, multiplier 3) and F-arm (even step, multiplier 1/2).

∋.justification: The rejoining of the arms to determine if the class contracts (3^j < 2^k) or survives.

⊤.justification: The affirmative state where 3^j >= 2^k, meaning the class does not contract and survives to depth k.

⊥.justification: The negative state where 3^j < 2^k, meaning the class contracts and descends.

⊞.justification: The paradice state where the class 2^k - 1 takes an odd step every time (j=k), holding both the growth (3^k) and the depth (2^k) in tension without resolving to contraction.

⊡.justification: The permanent record of the harmonic sum S_d = sum(1/(v+1)) which tracks the density of the tree.

phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: The integer n before any iteration, undefined in the context of the depth-k split.
phase_3.true_description: The class contracts: 3^j < 2^k, the trajectory descends below the seed.
phase_3.false_description: The class survives: 3^j >= 2^k, the trajectory remains above or at the seed.
phase_3.both_description: The all-odd class 2^k - 1: it grows by 3^k while the depth scale is 2^k, holding the contradiction of growth vs. depth without resolving to contraction.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the residue class r mod 2^k as the seed for the depth-k analysis.
Assert the self-reference of r, establishing that the parity sequence depends only on r.
Branch the trajectory based on the parity of the current value in the iteration.
Execute the odd-step morphism (3n+1)/2 on the T-arm, incrementing the odd-step count j.
Evaluate the affirmative condition that the odd-step multiplier 3 contributes to growth.
Execute the even-step morphism n/2 on the F-arm, preserving the odd-step count j.
Evaluate the negative condition that the even-step divisor 2 contributes to descent.
Compose the k steps sequentially to form the affine iterate col^[k](2^k*t + r).
Hold the all-odd class 2^k - 1 in the B state, where j=k and 3^k > 2^k, preventing contraction.
Rejoin the T and F arms to compute the contraction verdict 3^j < 2^k.
Record the harmonic sum contribution 1/(v+1) for the surviving nodes.
Chain the surviving classes to the next depth k+1.
Split the next depth level into even and odd lifts of the survivor.
Apply the odd lift to the T-arm, increasing the multiplier by 3.
Apply the even lift to the F-arm, doubling the divisor by 2.
Fuse the lifts to determine the new survival status at depth k+1.
Anchor the system at the 2-adic limit -1, the infinite survivor of the all-odd class.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The affine shift theorem col^[k](2^k*t + r) = 3^j*t + col^[k](r) which translates residue analysis into global behavior.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The parity sequence of the residue r mod 2^k which communicates the step types to the multiplier calculation.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The odd-step count j stored as the graded coordinate of the residue class.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The depth k which determines the number of iterations before the contraction check.
phase_5.alfs_store: The set of survivor residues mod 2^k, specifically the all-odd class 2^k - 1.

phase_6.cycle_cost: One bit of parity information per step, consumed to determine the multiplier/divisor ratio.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A residue class r mod 2^k with undefined contraction status.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A classified residue with a determined survival status (T, F, or B).
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system is entropy-conservative because the contraction check is a deterministic evaluation of the affine map, preserving the information of the residue class while resolving its fate.
